## Objective
- Build a playable 2D idle RPG combining Melvor Idle-style progression with Godville-style narration, animations, and uncapped offline progress.
- Add meaningful combat and crafting systems to the existing game.

## Requirements
- Build the game, making reasonable assumptions without asking questions.
- Continue progressing while the player is away with no offline-time cap.
- Add combat and crafting to the existing game.

## Decisions
- The game is “Odd Gods,” a self-contained browser game with localStorage saves and CSS-animated scenes.
- Existing resource gathering, quests, upgrades, humorous narration, and offline gains remain part of the game.

### Completed
- Built the existing game UI and idle progression in `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js`.
- Added README play instructions and fixed level calculation and quest progression.
- Previously verified JavaScript syntax and desktop/mobile rendering.

### Active
- Implement combat and crafting gameplay in the existing game; combat currently only operates as a passive “Fight slimes” resource action, and crafting is not implemented.

- (none)

1. Add functional combat progression and crafting recipes/actions to the existing game.
2. Connect their resources, skills, rewards, UI, and saving to current systems.
3. Run syntax and browser checks.

- `game.js`: Game state, actions, idle/offline progress, quests, upgrades, and modals.
- `index.html`: Game layout and navigation.
- `style.css`: Game styling, animations, and responsive layout.
- `README.md`: Local play instructions.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Existing resources include herbs, wood, ore, fish, coins, favor, and slime essence; combat currently grants coins and essence but has no enemy or battle mechanics.
- Progress is saved in browser `localStorage`; offline time is uncapped.
